hindi: अब इसलिए हम सन्तर्पणीय अध्याय की व्याख्या करेंगे।
english: Now, therefore, we shall expound the chapter on replenishing (Saṃtarpaṇīya).
notes: Prose opening formula of the chapter; the unit is typed as a verse in the input but is a prose line.

hindi: ऐसा भगवान् आत्रेय ने कहा।
english: Thus said the venerable Ātreya.
notes: Prose formula; ha and sma are particles, not rendered separately.

hindi: जो व्यक्ति स्निग्ध, मधुर, गुरु और पिच्छिल (पदार्थों) से, नए अन्न और नए मद्य से, तथा आनूप और जलचर (प्राणियों) के मांस से अपना सन्तर्पण करता है,
english: One who replenishes himself with unctuous, sweet, heavy and slimy (foods), with new grain and new wine, and with the meats of marsh and water (animals),
notes: The sentence runs from unit 3 to unit 7. ānūpa-vārija: marsh-dwelling and water-born; the word 'animals' is understood.

words.gloss: in the comfort of day-sleep, bed and seat

hindi: गोरस, गुड़ से बने अन्नों और आटे से बने पदार्थों से अत्यधिक मात्रा में (सन्तर्पण करता है), जो चेष्टा से द्वेष रखता है और दिन में सोने, शय्या तथा आसन के सुख में रत रहता है,
english: with milk products, with foods made of guḍa and with flour preparations, in excessive measure, who is averse to exertion and delights in the comfort of day-sleep, bed and seat,
notes: Continues unit 3. gauḍika 'made of guḍa (jaggery)'; paiṣṭika 'made of flour (piṣṭa)'. gorasa covers milk and its products.

words.gloss: prameha, eruptions, koṭha, itching, pāṇḍu disease and fever

hindi: उसमें सन्तर्पण के कारण उत्पन्न होने वाले रोग पैदा होते हैं: प्रमेह, पिडका, कोठ, खुजली, पाण्डुरोग और ज्वर,
english: in him arise the diseases caused by replenishing (saṃtarpaṇa): prameha, eruptions (piḍakā), koṭha (rashes), itching, pāṇḍu disease and fever,
notes: The list of diseases runs to unit 7. pāṇḍvāmaya = pāṇḍu + āmaya 'the disease pāṇḍu'.

hindi: कुष्ठ, आम के विकार, मूत्रकृच्छ्र, अरोचक, तन्द्रा, क्लीबता, अत्यधिक स्थूलता, आलस्य, अंगों का भारीपन,
english: kuṣṭhas, disorders of āma (undigested matter), mūtrakṛcchra, loss of taste (arocaka), drowsiness, impotence, excessive corpulence, laziness, heaviness of the limbs,
notes: āmapradoṣa may also be read 'disorders due to āma'; the sense is the same.

words.gram: m. gen. sg., pres. part. neg. prati-√kṛ

hindi: इन्द्रियों और स्रोतों पर लेप, बुद्धि का मोह, प्रमीलक, शोफ और इसी प्रकार के अन्य (रोग) — उस व्यक्ति में, जो शीघ्र प्रतिकार नहीं करता।
english: coating of the senses and channels, clouding of the intellect, stupor (pramīlaka), swellings and others of this kind — in one who does not quickly counteract (them).
notes: indriyasrotasām may also be a tat-puruṣa, 'of the channels of the senses'. śīghram may go with apratikurvataḥ ('does not counteract quickly') or with the arising of the diseases ('arise quickly in one who does not counteract'); the first is taken.

hindi: उसमें उल्लेखन, विरेक, रक्तमोक्षण, व्यायाम, उपवास, धूम और स्वेदन प्रशस्त हैं।
english: In that case vomiting (ullekhana), purgation, bloodletting, exercise, fasting, medicated smoking (dhūma) and sweatings are commended,
notes: śastam (n. sg.) agrees with the nearest noun but serves the whole list; the list continues into unit 9.

hindi: मधु के साथ अभया का प्राश, प्रायः रूक्ष अन्न का सेवन, और खुजली तथा कोठ का नाश करने वाले जो चूर्ण-प्रदेह कहे गए हैं (वे प्रशस्त हैं)।
english: the licking of abhayā with honey, mostly the use of dry food, and the powder-plasters that have been stated as destroying itching and koṭha.
notes: Continues the list of unit 8. The chunk does not say where the powder-plasters were stated. Identification: abhayā = Terminalia chebula (standard).

hindi: त्रिफला, आरग्वध, पाठा, वत्सक सहित सप्तपर्ण, मदन सहित मुस्त और निम्ब को जल में उबालकर पीना चाहिए।
english: One should drink triphalā and āragvadha, pāṭhā, saptaparṇa with vatsaka, musta with madana, and nimba, boiled in water.
notes: triphalā 'the three fruits' is a group name.

words.gram: m. gen. sg., pres. part. abhi-√as

words.gloss: administered with due measure and time

hindi: मात्रा और काल के अनुसार प्रयुक्त उस (क्वाथ) से, उसका निरन्तर सेवन करने वाले के सन्तर्पण से उत्पन्न मेह आदि (रोग) निश्चय ही नष्ट हो जाते हैं।
english: By that, administered with due measure and time, meha and the other (disorders) arising from replenishing surely perish in one who uses it regularly.

hindi: मुस्त, आरग्वध, पाठा, त्रिफला और देवदारु, श्वदंष्ट्रा, खदिर, निम्ब, दोनों हरिद्रा और वत्सक की छाल —
english: Musta, āragvadha, pāṭhā, triphalā and devadāru, śvadaṃṣṭrā, khadira, nimba, the two haridrās, and bark from vatsaka:
notes: List of drugs; the sentence continues into unit 13. Identification: haridrā = turmeric, Curcuma longa (standard).
lines_deva: श्वदंष्ट्रा खदिरो निम्बो हरिद्रे त्वक्च वत्सकात्
lines_iast: śvadaṃṣṭrā khadiro nimbo haridre tvakca vatsakāt

hindi: इनका रस दोष के अनुसार प्रतिदिन प्रातःकाल पीने वाला मनुष्य सन्तर्पण से उत्पन्न सभी व्याधियों से मुक्त हो जाता है।
english: A man who drinks the juice of these every morning, according to the doṣa, is freed from all diseases caused by replenishing.
notes: rasa here is the liquid (juice or extract) of the drugs, not a taste. prātaḥ prātaḥ (repeated) = every morning.

words.gloss: employed in applications of rubbing, friction and bathing

hindi: और उद्वर्तन, उद्घर्षण तथा स्नान के प्रयोगों में प्रयुक्त इन (द्रव्यों) से, तथा स्नेह से युक्त इनसे, त्वचा के दोष शान्त हो जाते हैं।
english: And by these, employed in applications of rubbing (udvartana), friction (udgharṣa) and bathing, and likewise combined with unctuous substance (sneha), skin disorders subside.
notes: ebhiḥ refers to the drugs of unit 12.

hindi: कुष्ठ, गोमेदक, हिंगु, क्रौञ्च की अस्थि, त्र्यूषण, वचा, वृषक और एला, श्वदंष्ट्रा, खराह्वा और अश्मभेदक —
english: Kuṣṭha, gomedaka, hiṅgu, bone of the krauñca, the three pungents (tryūṣaṇa), vacā, vṛṣaka and elā, śvadaṃṣṭrā, kharāhvā and aśmabhedaka:
notes: kuṣṭha here is a drug, not the disease. gomedaka is left unidentified. krauñca is a bird name, kept. The list continues into unit 16. Identification: hiṅgu = asafoetida (standard).
lines_deva: कुष्ठं गोमेदको हिङ्गु क्रौञ्चास्थि त्र्यूषणं वचा
lines_iast: kuṣṭhaṃ gomedako hiṅgu krauñcāsthi tryūṣaṇaṃ vacā

words.gloss: with the sour juice of badara

hindi: यह (योग) तक्र, दधिमण्ड या बदर के अम्ल रस के साथ पिया जाने पर मूत्रकृच्छ्र और प्रमेह को दूर करता है।
english: This, drunk with buttermilk, with dadhimaṇḍa (the clear part of curd) or with the sour juice of badara, removes mūtrakṛcchra and prameha.
notes: etat sums up the drugs of unit 15. Identification: badara = jujube (standard).

words.gloss: by administrations of buttermilk and abhayā

hindi: तक्र और अभया के प्रयोगों से, उसी प्रकार त्रिफला के (प्रयोगों से), और अरिष्टों के प्रयोगों से मेह आदि शान्त हो जाते हैं।
english: By administrations of buttermilk and abhayā, and in just the same way (by those) of triphalā, and by administrations of ariṣṭas, meha and the others subside.
notes: takrābhayā may also be one item, 'abhayā with buttermilk'; taken as two. triphalāyāḥ depends on prayogaiḥ understood.

hindi: त्र्यूषण, त्रिफला, मधु, कृमिघ्न, अजमोदक, सत्तू और तैल — लोह के जल में मिलाया हुआ यह मन्थ हितकर है।
english: Tryūṣaṇa, triphalā, honey, krimighna, ajamodaka, saktu (roasted flour) and oil: this mantha, steeped in metal-water, is beneficial.
notes: krimighna literally 'worm-destroying' is taken as a drug name; the chunk does not say which drug. lohodaka, literally 'metal-water'; the chunk does not say how it is made.

hindi: व्योष, विडङ्ग, शिग्रु, त्रिफला, कटुरोहिणी, दोनों बृहती, दोनों हरिद्रा, पाठा, अतिविषा, स्थिरा,
english: Vyoṣa, viḍaṅga, śigru, triphalā, kaṭurohiṇī, the two bṛhatīs, the two haridrās, pāṭhā, ativiṣā, sthirā,
notes: List of ingredients; the sentence ends with cūrṇayet in unit 20.
lines_deva: बृहत्यौ द्वे हरिद्रे द्वे पाठामतिविषां स्थिराम्
lines_iast: bṛhatyau dve haridre dve pāṭhāmativiṣāṃ sthirām

hindi: हिंगु, केबुक की जड़ें, यवानी, धान्य, चित्रक, सौवर्चल, अजाजी और हपुषा — इनका चूर्ण बनाना चाहिए।
english: hiṅgu, roots of kebuka, yavānī, dhānya and citraka, sauvarcala (salt), ajājī and hapuṣā: these one should powder.

words.gloss: the portions of powder, oil, ghee and honey

hindi: चूर्ण, तैल, घृत और मधु के भाग मात्रा में बराबर हों; सत्तू का भाग सोलह गुना हो; (इस) सन्तर्पण को पीना चाहिए।
english: The portions of powder, oil, ghee and honey should be equal by measure, and the portion of saktu sixteenfold; one should drink (this) replenishing preparation (saṃtarpaṇa).
notes: ṣoḍaśaguṇa 'sixteenfold' does not say of what (of one portion, or of all together). saṃtarpaṇa here names the drink made with saktu; unit 22 shows it is used against the diseases arising from replenishing.

hindi: इसके प्रयोग से सन्तर्पण से उत्पन्न रोग शान्त होते हैं: प्रमेह, मूढवात, कुष्ठ, अर्श, कामला,
english: From the use of this the diseases arising from replenishing subside: pramehas, obstructed Vāta (mūḍhavāta), kuṣṭhas, arśas, kāmalās,
notes: The list continues to unit 24.

hindi: प्लीहा, पाण्डुरोग, शोफ, मूत्रकृच्छ्र, अरोचक, हृद्रोग, राजयक्ष्मा, कास, श्वास, गलग्रह,
english: spleen disorder (plīhā), pāṇḍu disease, swelling, mūtrakṛcchra, loss of taste, heart disease, rājayakṣman, cough, dyspnoea, galagraha,
notes: plīhā (the spleen) stands for the disorder of the spleen in this list.
lines_deva: हृद्रोगो राजयक्ष्मा च कासः श्वासो गलग्रहः
lines_iast: hṛdrogo rājayakṣmā ca kāsaḥ śvāso galagrahaḥ

hindi: कृमि, ग्रहणी-दोष, श्वैत्र्य और अत्यधिक स्थूलता (शान्त होते हैं); और मनुष्यों की अग्नि प्रदीप्त होती है, स्मृति और बुद्धि बढ़ती हैं।
english: worms (krimi), grahaṇī disorders, śvaitrya (whiteness of skin) and excessive corpulence; and men's digestive fire is kindled, and memory and intellect increase.
notes: vardhate is singular with two subjects (smṛtiḥ, buddhiḥ).

words.gloss: whose food is barley and wheat

hindi: जो नित्य व्यायाम करता है, (पहले भोजन के) पच जाने पर खाता है, और जौ तथा गेहूँ का भोजन करता है, वह स्थूलता छोड़कर सन्तर्पण से उत्पन्न दोषों से मुक्त हो जाता है।
english: One who is constant in exercise, eats after (the previous meal) is digested, and has barley and wheat for food, sheds corpulence and is freed from the disorders caused by replenishing.

text_flags.why: possible typo: jīrṇa + aśin 'eating (when the food is) digested' gives jīrṇāśī with long ā by sandhi; jīrṇaśī with short a is not a regular form. Metre supports it: in the odd pāda vyāyāmanityo jīrṇaśī syllables 5-7 (tyo jīr ṇa) are long-long-short, not an allowed anuṣṭubh pattern; with ṇā they are long-long-long (ma-vipulā).

notes: doṣa here means the disorders (ills) caused by replenishing, not the three doṣas specifically.

hindi: सन्तर्पण से उत्पन्न (रोगों) की औषध अपतर्पण कही गई; अब आगे अपतर्पण से उत्पन्न रोग उनकी औषधों सहित कहे जाएँगे।
english: Depletion (apatarpaṇa), the medicine for those (diseases) arising from replenishing (saṃtarpaṇa), has been stated; hereafter the diseases born of depletion will be stated with their medicines.

words.gloss: wasting of body, digestive fire, strength, complexion, ojas, semen and flesh

hindi: देह, अग्नि, बल, वर्ण, ओज, शुक्र और मांस का क्षय, ज्वर, कास का अनुबन्ध, पार्श्वशूल, अरोचक,
english: Wasting of body, digestive fire, strength, complexion, ojas (vital essence), semen and flesh; fever, persistence of cough, pain in the sides, loss of taste,
notes: The list of diseases born of depletion runs to unit 29. kāsānubandha may also mean 'cough as a sequel'.

words.gloss: located in the shanks, thighs and trika (lower back)

hindi: श्रवण की दुर्बलता, उन्माद, प्रलाप, हृदय की व्यथा, मल और मूत्र का रुकना, जंघा, ऊरु और त्रिक में होने वाला शूल,
english: weakness of hearing, insanity, delirious talk, pain in the heart, retention of faeces and urine, pain located in the shanks, thighs and trika (lower back),

words.gloss: breaking pain in the small joints (parvan), bones and joints

hindi: पर्वों, अस्थियों और सन्धियों में तोड़ने जैसी पीड़ा, और वात से उत्पन्न जो अन्य रोग हैं, ऊर्ध्ववात आदि — वे सब अपतर्पण से उत्पन्न होते हैं।
english: breaking pain in the small joints (parvan), bones and joints, and the other diseases born of Vāta, ūrdhvavāta (upward Vāta) and the rest: all these arise from depletion.

text_flags.why: possible typo (म/भ look alike): as printed -medaḥ 'fat' names a tissue, not a disorder, while the same line goes on 'ye cānye vātajā gadāḥ' ('and the other diseases born of Vāta'), so the item should itself be a Vāta disorder; bheda 'breaking pain' gives that sense. The syllable count is unchanged.

notes: parvan is taken as the small joints (of the fingers); it can mean any joint or knot.

hindi: उनके लिए उसके जानकारों ने फिर सन्तर्पण को औषध बताया है; जो तत्काल समर्थ हो या निरन्तर सेवन से समर्थ हो, वह अभीष्ट है।
english: For them, those who know it have declared replenishing (saṃtarpaṇa), in turn, as the medicine: that which may be effective at once or with continued use is wanted.
notes: punaḥ 'again, in turn' contrasts with depletion as medicine in unit 26. Line b may mean that the replenishing measure is chosen as quick-acting or as acting with continued use, as unit 31 explains.

words.gloss: one wasted for a long time

hindi: क्योंकि जो सहसा क्षीण हुआ है, वह तर्पण से तुरन्त पुष्ट हो जाता है; किन्तु जो चिरकाल से क्षीण है, वह सन्तर्पण के निरन्तर सेवन के बिना पुष्ट नहीं होता।
english: For one wasted suddenly is indeed built up quickly by tarpaṇa (replenishing); but one wasted over a long time does not thrive without continued replenishing (saṃtarpaṇa).

words.gloss: by one who follows body, digestive fire, doṣa, medicine, measure and time
words.gram: m. inst. sg., upapada tat-puruṣa (dvandva inside)
m. inst. sg., pres. part. ātm. neg. √tvar

hindi: चिरकाल से दुर्बल व्यक्ति के लिए औषध, देह, अग्नि, दोष, भैषज्य, मात्रा और काल का अनुसरण करने वाले (चिकित्सक) द्वारा बिना जल्दबाजी के दिया जाना चाहिए।
english: For one long weak, the medicine is to be given without haste by one who pays regard to the body, digestive fire, doṣa, medicine, measure and time.
notes: kāryam literally 'is to be done (made)'. The agent (a physician) is understood.

hindi: उसके लिए मांसरस, दूध और घृत, स्नान, बस्ति, अभ्यङ्ग और जो तर्पण हैं, वे हितकर हैं।
english: Beneficial for him are meat-juices, milks and ghees, baths, enemas (basti), oil massages and those which are tarpaṇas (replenishing preparations).
notes: GAP: the second half-line (snānāni bastayo'bhyaṅgās tarpaṇāś ca ye) has 13 syllables against the 16 of the first, and the relative clause 'tarpaṇāś ca ye' is incomplete; some words seem lost. No correction can be made from the chunk; the translation keeps the line as printed.
lines_deva: हिता मांसरसास्तस्मै पयांसि च घृतानि च
lines_iast: hitā māṃsarasāstasmai payāṃsi ca ghṛtāni ca

words.gloss: of those afflicted with fever and cough

hindi: ज्वर और कास से ग्रस्त, कृश, मूत्रकृच्छ्र वाले, प्यासे और ऊर्ध्ववात वाले लोगों के लिए हितकर तर्पण कहे जाएँगे।
english: For those afflicted with fever and cough, the emaciated, those with mūtrakṛcchra, the thirsty and those with upward Vāta (ūrdhvavāta), beneficial tarpaṇas (replenishing preparations) will be described.

words.gloss: with sugar, pippalī, oil, ghee and honey

hindi: शर्करा, पिप्पली, तैल, घृत और मधु समान भागों में और सत्तू दुगुना — ऐसा वृष्य मन्थ उनके लिए प्रशस्त है।
english: For them is commended an aphrodisiac mantha with sugar, pippalī, oil, ghee and honey in equal parts, and saktu doubled.
notes: saktudviguṇita: the saktu is twice (the other ingredients); the text does not say twice each or twice all together. Identification: pippalī = long pepper, Piper longum (standard).

words.gloss: moving downward Vāta, faeces, urine, Kapha and Pitta

hindi: सत्तू, मदिरा, मधु और शर्करा — यह तर्पण पीना चाहिए, जो मारुत, मल, मूत्र, कफ और पित्त का अनुलोमन करता है।
english: Saktu, madirā, honey and sugar: this tarpaṇa (replenishing preparation) one should drink; it moves Vāta (māruta), faeces, urine, Kapha and Pitta downward.
lines_deva: सक्तवो मदिरा क्षौद्रं शर्करा चेति तर्पणम्
lines_iast: saktavo madirā kṣaudraṃ śarkarā ceti tarpaṇam

hindi: फाणित, सत्तू, घृत, दधिमण्ड और अम्ल काञ्जिक — मूत्रकृच्छ्र को नष्ट करने वाला और उदावर्त को हरने वाला यह तर्पण पीना चाहिए।
english: Phāṇita, saktu, ghee, dadhimaṇḍa and sour kāñjika: one should drink this tarpaṇa (replenishing preparation), which destroys mūtrakṛcchra and removes udāvarta.

text_flags.why: possible typo (missing ā-sign): phaṇita (ppp. of √phaṇ) is not a substance; phāṇita fits this list of ingredients (saktavaḥ, sarpiḥ, dadhimaṇḍa, amlakāñjika). Metre is unaffected (first syllable).

notes: kāñjika is a sour fermented liquid; amla 'sour' may also be a separate item (a sour liquid) beside kāñjika.

words.gloss: with kharjūra, mṛdvīkā, vṛkṣāmla, amlīka and dāḍima

hindi: खर्जूर, मृद्वीका, वृक्षाम्ल, अम्लीका और दाडिम से, तथा आमलक सहित परूषक से युक्त मन्थ मद्य के विकारों को दूर करता है।
english: A mantha combined with kharjūra, mṛdvīkā, vṛkṣāmla, amlīka and dāḍima, and with parūṣaka together with āmalaka, dispels the disorders of wine (madya).
notes: Identifications: kharjūra = date (standard); mṛdvīkā = grape (standard); dāḍima = pomegranate (standard); āmalaka = Phyllanthus emblica (standard).

words.gram: m. nom. sg., upapada tat-puruṣa (dvandva inside)

hindi: मधुर या अम्ल, जल से बनाया हुआ, स्नेह सहित या रूक्ष ही — मन्थ तुरन्त सन्तर्पण करने वाला है और स्थिरता, वर्ण तथा बल देता है।
english: Sweet or sour, made with water, with unctuous substance or just dry, the mantha is at once replenishing (saṃtarpaṇa) and gives firmness, complexion and strength.
notes: svāduḥ amlaḥ may also be read together, 'sweet-and-sour'; 'or' is supplied in the translation.
lines_deva: स्वादुरम्लो जलकृतः सस्नेहो रूक्ष एव वा
lines_iast: svāduramlo jalakṛtaḥ sasneho rūkṣa eva vā

hindi: यहाँ श्लोक है: सन्तर्पण से उत्पन्न जो रोग हैं और अपतर्पण से जो रोग होते हैं, वे औषधों सहित सन्तर्पणीय अध्याय में कहे गए हैं।
english: Here, the verse: The diseases that arise from replenishing and the diseases that (arise) from depletion have been set forth, with their medicines, in the chapter Saṃtarpaṇīya.
notes: Summary verse of the chapter.
lines_deva: संतर्पणोत्था ये रोगा रोगा ये चापतर्पणात्
lines_iast: saṃtarpaṇotthā ye rogā rogā ye cāpatarpaṇāt

hindi: इस प्रकार अग्निवेश द्वारा रचित, चरक द्वारा प्रतिसंस्कृत तन्त्र के श्लोकस्थान में सन्तर्पणीय नामक तेईसवाँ अध्याय।
english: Thus, in the treatise composed by Agniveśa and redacted by Caraka, in the Śloka section (Ślokasthāna), the twenty-third chapter named Saṃtarpaṇīya.
notes: Chapter colophon; the Sanskrit has no verb and the translation keeps it verbless.
lines_deva: इत्यग्निवेशकृते तन्त्रे चरकप्रतिसंस्कृते श्लोकस्थाने संतर्पणीयो नाम त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः
lines_iast: ityagniveśakṛte tantre carakapratisaṃskṛte ślokasthāne saṃtarpaṇīyo nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ
